from contextlib import contextmanager
class FakeContext:
 def __init__(self):self.value=None
 def get(self):return self.value
 def set(self,value):old=self.value;self.value=value;return old
 def reset(self,token):self.value=token
request_id=FakeContext()
@contextmanager
def request(value):
 token=request_id.set(value)
 try:yield
 finally:request_id.reset(token)

import asyncio
async def scoped(value,delay):
 import contextvars
 token=current.set(value)
 try:
  await asyncio.sleep(delay)
  result=current.get()
 except Exception:
  current.reset(token);raise
 else:
  current.reset(token);return result

current=contextvars.ContextVar('current',default=None)
